subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word 'Ceased' to fill in the blank.

He was ______ from his job because of his misconduct.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (terminated)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ceased"** means to stop, bring to an end, or discontinue something. (बंद करना, समाप्त करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The factory ceased operations due to financial losses.
 
 
 
• **"Terminated"** refers to bringing something to an end, especially in a formal or permanent way. (समाप्त करना, नौकरी से निकालना)
 
 
• **Example:** The employee was terminated for violating company policies.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym of "ceased" in the given sentence is "terminated."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (terminated)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: Continued** (जारी रखना): To persist in an activity or process without stopping.

 
 
• **Example:** She continued to work hard despite the challenges.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Commenced** (शुरू करना): To begin or start something.
 
 
• **Example:** The meeting commenced at 10 AM sharp.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Progressed** (आगे बढ़ना): To move forward or develop towards a better stage.
 
 
• **Example:** The project progressed smoothly under the new management.
 
 

1c5:Tc6c,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.<
